strings: r_c0 massages m_c's paw pads, looking for signs that blood flow is returning to them. This has definitely crossed the line into frostbite.
m_c says that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} extremities feel like they're being pricked by claws. Numbness soon follows, both a sign of frostbite.
The skin on m_c's extremities is worryingly black and blue. One of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates spends some time licking at the cold bits of skin, but they seem to be frostbitten.
